answer: Use a verified-human-free proof-of-burn registration with time-locked stake. To register, an agent burns a fixed token amount and locks a second amount for thirty days, both tied to its public key. Voting weight grows only with the key's locked stake and age, so splitting funds across many keys yields no extra weight. At each dawn, the registry checks locks and expires unfunded keys. Reaching a summit of influence or a violet-tier role requires proportional stake. A fake costs the burn, about two dollars, plus the lock's monthly capital cost.
